videos.headline: McConkey takes end around 9 yards to the house
videos.description: Ladd McConkey takes the end around and weaves through the defense for 9-yard touchdown run.

videos.headline: Malaki Starks high-points a Bo Nix pass for remarkable INT
videos.description: Malaki Starks impresses with an interception on a deep pass from Bo Nix.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Malaki Starks high-points a Bo Nix pass for remarkable INT) 2022/09/03

videos.headline: Stetson Bennett's TD run fakes out the whole Oregon defense
videos.description: Stetson Bennett uses the play fake to perfection as he walks in for the 1-yard touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Stetson Bennett's TD run fakes out the whole Oregon defense) 2022/09/03

videos.headline: Bo Nix throws an INT right into defender's hands
videos.description: Bo Nix misreads the coverage and throws it right to Georgia's Christopher Smith for his second interception of the day.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Bo Nix throws an INT right into defender's hands) 2022/09/03

videos.headline: McIntosh waltzes into end zone for Georgia's 3rd TD of the day
videos.description: Kenny McIntosh takes the end around and scores an easy touchdown, extending Georgia's lead to 21-0.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (McIntosh waltzes into end zone for Georgia's 3rd TD of the day) 2022/09/03

videos.headline: Stetson Bennett's Houdini act results in the TD
videos.description: Stetson Bennett somehow avoids the sack and finds a wide-open Ladd McConkey for the touchdown before halftime.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Stetson Bennett's Houdini act results in the TD) 2022/09/03

videos.headline: Kendall Milton loses a tackler in the backfield, then scores easy TD
videos.description: Kendall Milton piles it on for Georgia as he loses a tackler in the backfield and walks into end zone for 12-yard touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Kendall Milton loses a tackler in the backfield, then scores easy TD) 2022/09/03

videos.headline: Adonai Mitchell outmuscles corner for Georgia TD
videos.description: Stetson Bennett throws the back-shoulder fade to Adonai Mitchell, who hauls it in for the 18-yard touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Adonai Mitchell outmuscles corner for Georgia TD) 2022/09/03

videos.headline: Kendall Milton scores Georgia's 7th TD on their 7th possession
videos.description: Kendall Milton hauls in the 18-yard touchdown, continuing Georgia's dominance over Oregon.

videos.headline: Stetson Bennett balls out in Georgia's dominant win over Oregon
videos.description: Stetson Bennett rushes for a touchdown and throws for two, leading Georgia to the huge 49-3 win over Oregon.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF Highlight (Stetson Bennett balls out in Georgia’s dominant win over Oregon) 2022/09/03 ESHEET SOTFULL

videos.headline: UGA's Bennett credits better timing with receivers
videos.description: After throwing for a career-high 368 yards in a 49-3 win over Oregon, QB Stetson Bennett says his chemistry with Georgia receivers is better than ever.
